terminology: X1 is a deliberately mismatched authority (matched mismatched-authority perturbation); it is not claimed to be factually wrong or non-authoritative

conditions.D1: predicted top-1 publisher keys (highest-ranked predicted entry with a usable key), as in Phase 1
conditions.X1: one publisher key chosen by the rules below; same rerank, lambda = 1, same frozen hybrid top-100 pool

analysis_set_S: gold-reachable held-out claims whose D1 publisher has >=1 document in the frozen hybrid top-100 pool (expected n = 79)

eligibility.E1: publisher key has >=1 document in the claim's frozen hybrid top-100 pool
eligibility.E2: publisher is not a reachable human-gold publisher of the claim (gold used only here and for scoring)
eligibility.E3: publisher is not among the claim's predicted top-3 publisher keys
eligibility.E4: publisher has the same existing generic-prior category as the claim's D1 publisher

selection: eligible publisher with pool document count closest to D1's; ties: random.Random(2029 * 100000 + claim_id).choice(sorted(tied_keys))
assignment_integrity: assignment CSV written once, SHA-256 recorded, both files made read-only; scorer verifies the hash before and after scoring
gate: A0 equals stored system A top-100 rankings (200 claims); A0 and D1 per-claim first-gold ranks equal Phase 1 (167 claims)
endpoint: human-gold R@1/5/10/20/50/100, MRR@100, pool coverage on S
statistics: family AQA-P2: R@10 D1 vs A0, X1 vs A0, X1 vs D1; exact McNemar; paired bootstrap 95% CI (seed 2026); Holm within these three only. R@5 and R@20 descriptive.
